user.title: Connect to BetaSeries
user.description: Enter the API key and client secret from your personal BetaSeries API application (create one at {betaserie_api_url}).

data_description.locale: Language BetaSeries responses (genres, descriptions, error messages) are returned in. Changeable later in the integration's options. Note: BetaSeries currently ignores this setting and replies in your BetaSeries account's own language, so changing it may have no visible effect.
